craft_notes: Sthāyin: warning-dread (trustless). Sanskrit first: instrumental teaching, negated trust, questioned fruit → L4 keeps the chill, colon lands the question. Rows: row 8 (dark vowels within/win). Rupture: colon after within — setup held, question released. Close: end-weight on the un-won fruit. Minimal pass: colon for L3 dash. Read aloud: taught, empty, questioned. Rejected: 'faith' for āśvāsa — killed: trust is relational, faith doctrinal; 'liberation' for naiḥśreyasa — kept beatitude? L4 says freedom — freedom kept (mokṣa-register consistent).

lines: Taught yoga's knowing, yet with no trust within:
trustless — how should he ever freedom win?
l4.sanskrit_cite: jñānayogopadeśena yasya nāśvāsa āntaraḥ / samāśvāsavihīnatvāt kathaṃ naiḥśreyasaṃ phalam
